{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rule by the Strong''' was a theory that emerged in the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Republic Dark Age]]. Its creator, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Skere Kaan]], argued that the strong should see their power increase while the weak should see their power decrease.<ref name="END">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref> That philosophy was also present in the culture of the [[Ailon (species)/Legends|Ailon]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> Under that rule, Lord Kaan and his allies sought to topple both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and install a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[theocracy]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> With the rise of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] and his [[Order of the Sith Lords]], the Rule by the Strong was supplanted by the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], which reduced the number of Sith Lords to a single pair at a time: a [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] and an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]]. However, the three-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] [[mutant]] called [[Darth Millennial]], although he was a Banite Sith, decided to resurrect the Rule by the Strong. In order to do so, Millennial rebelled against the teachings of his master [[Darth Cognus]], and he left the Order to create the [[Dark Force]] religion.<ref name="END" />
